migrations.name: abstract-control-parent
migrations.description: In Angular version 11, the type of `AbstractControl.parent` can be `null` to reflect the runtime value more accurately. This migration automatically adds non-null assertions to existing accesses of the `parent` property on types like `FormControl`, `FormArray` and `FormGroup`.

migrations.name: activated-route-snapshot-fragment
migrations.description: In Angular version 12, the type of ActivatedRouteSnapshot.fragment is nullable. This migration automatically adds non-null assertions to it.

migrations.name: add-bootstrap-context-to-server-main
migrations.description: Adds `BootstrapContext` to `bootstrapApplication` calls in `main.server.ts` to support server rendering.

migrations.name: add-browser-sync-dependency
migrations.description: Add 'browser-sync' as dev dependency when '@angular-devkit/build-angular:ssr-dev-server' is used, as it is no longer a direct dependency of '@angular-devkit/build-angular'.

migrations.name: add-declaration-map-compiler-option
migrations.description: Add 'declarationMap' compiler options for non production library builds.

migrations.name: add-istanbul-instrumenter
migrations.description: Add 'istanbul-lib-instrument' to 'devDependencies' if Karma unit testing is used.

migrations.name: after-render-phase
migrations.description: Updates calls to afterRender with an explicit phase to the new API

migrations.name: application-config-core
migrations.description: Moves imports of `ApplicationConfig` from `@angular/platform-browser` to `@angular/core`

migrations.name: block-template-entities
migrations.description: Angular v17 introduces a new control flow syntax that uses the @ and } characters. This migration replaces the existing usages with their corresponding HTML entities.

migrations.name: bootstrap-options-migration
migrations.description: Migrates deprecated bootstrap options to providers.

migrations.name: can-activate-with-redirect-to
migrations.description: Removes `canActivate` from a `Route` config when `redirectTo` is also present

migrations.name: can-match-snapshot-required
migrations.description: Adds the required third argument to canMatch callsites.

migrations.name: change-detection-eager
migrations.description: Adds `ChangeDetectionStrategy.Eager` to all components.

migrations.name: compiler-options
migrations.description: CompilerOption.useJit and CompilerOption.missingTranslation are unused under Ivy. This migration removes their usage

migrations.name: control-flow-migration
migrations.description: Converts the entire application to block control flow syntax

migrations.name: deep-shadow-piercing-selector
migrations.description: Automatically migrates shadow-piercing selector from `/deep/` to the recommanded alternative `::ng-deep`.

migrations.name: document-core
migrations.description: Moves imports of `DOCUMENT` from `@angular/common` to `@angular/core`

migrations.name: drop-ie-polyfills
migrations.description: Remove polyfills required only for Internet Explorer which is no longer supported.

migrations.name: dynamic-queries
migrations.description: Static flag migration. Removes the `static` flag from dynamic queries. As of Angular 9, the "static" flag defaults to false and is no longer required for your view and content queries. Read more about this here: https://v9.angular.io/guide/migration-dynamic-flag

migrations.name: entry-components
migrations.description: As of Angular version 13, `entryComponents` are no longer necessary.

migrations.name: explicit-standalone-flag
migrations.description: Updates non-standalone Directives, Component and Pipes to 'standalone:false' and removes 'standalone:true' from those who are standalone

migrations.name: guard-and-resolve-interfaces
migrations.description: In Angular version 15.2, the guard and resolver interfaces (CanActivate, Resolve, etc) were deprecated. This migration removes imports and 'implements' clauses that contain them.

migrations.name: http-providers
migrations.description: Replace deprecated HTTP related modules with provider functions

migrations.name: http-xhr-backend
migrations.description: Adds 'withXhr' to 'provideHttpClient' function calls when the 'HttpXhrBackend' is used. For more information see: https://angular.dev/api/common/http/withXhr

migrations.name: incremental-hydration
migrations.description: Adds withNoIncrementalHydration() opt out to provideClientHydration() when incremental hydration is not enabled to retain pre-v22 behavior-.

migrations.name: inject-flags
migrations.description: Replaces usages of the deprecated InjectFlags enum

migrations.name: invalid-two-way-bindings
migrations.description: Updates two-way bindings that have an invalid expression to use the longform expression instead.

migrations.name: lazy-loading-string-syntax
migrations.description: Lazy loading syntax migration. Update lazy loading string syntax to use dynamic imports.

migrations.name: lazy-loading-syntax
migrations.description: Lazy loading syntax migration. Update lazy loading syntax to use dynamic imports.

migrations.name: migrate-karma-to-vitest
migrations.description: Migrate projects using legacy Karma unit-test builder to the new unit-test builder with Vitest.

migrations.name: missing-injectable
migrations.description: Missing @Injectable and incomplete provider definition migration. In Angular 9, enforcement of @Injectable decorators for DI is a bit stricter and incomplete provider definitions behave differently. Read more about this here: https://v9.angular.io/guide/migration-injectable

migrations.name: model-output
migrations.description: Migrate broken duplicate outputs

migrations.name: module-with-providers
migrations.description: ModuleWithProviders migration. In Angular 9, the ModuleWithProviders type without a generic has been deprecated. This migration adds the generic where it is missing. Read more about this here: https://v9.angular.io/guide/migration-module-with-providers

migrations.name: move-document
migrations.description: Migrates DOCUMENT Injection token from platform-browser imports to common import

migrations.name: native-view-encapsulation
migrations.description: ViewEncapsulation.Native has been removed as of Angular version 11. This migration replaces any usages with ViewEncapsulation.ShadowDom.

migrations.name: navigation-extras-omissions
migrations.description: NavigationExtras omissions migration. In version 11, some unsupported properties were omitted from the `extras` parameter of the `Router.navigateByUrl` and `Router.createUrlTree` methods.

migrations.name: path-match-type
migrations.description: In Angular version 14, the `pathMatch` property of `Routes` was updated to be a strict union of the two valid options: `'full'|'prefix'`. `Routes` and `Route` variables need an explicit type so TypeScript does not infer the property as the looser `string`.

migrations.name: pending-tasks
migrations.description: Updates ExperimentalPendingTasks to PendingTasks

migrations.name: previous-style-guide
migrations.description: Update workspace generation defaults to maintain previous style guide behavior.

migrations.name: provide-initializer
migrations.description: Replaces `APP_INITIALIZER`, `ENVIRONMENT_INITIALIZER` & `PLATFORM_INITIALIZER` respectively with `provideAppInitializer`, `provideEnvironmentInitializer` & `providePlatformInitializer`.

migrations.name: relative-link-resolution
migrations.description: In Angular version 15, the deprecated `relativeLinkResolution` config parameter of the Router is removed. This migration removes all `relativeLinkResolution` fields from the Router config objects.

migrations.name: remove-browserslist-config
migrations.description: Remove Browserslist configuration files that matches the Angular CLI default configuration.

migrations.name: remove-default-karma-config
migrations.description: Remove any karma configuration files that only contain the default content. The default configuration is automatically available without a specific project file.

migrations.name: remove-default-project-option
migrations.description: Remove 'defaultProject' option from workspace configuration. The project to use will be determined from the current working directory.

migrations.name: remove-deprecated-i18n-options
migrations.description: Remove deprecated ViewEngine-based i18n build and extract options. Options present in the configuration will be converted to use non-deprecated options.

migrations.name: remove-emit-decorator-metadata
migrations.description: Remove 'emitDecoratorMetadata' TypeScript compiler option. Decorator metadata is no longer needed by Angular. Read more about this here: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/decorators.html#metadata

migrations.name: remove-es5-browser-support-option
migrations.description: Remove deprecated 'es5BrowserSupport' browser builder option. The inclusion for ES5 polyfills will be determined from the browsers listed in the browserslist configuration.

migrations.name: remove-module-id
migrations.description: As of Angular v16, the `moduleId` property of `@Component` is deprecated as it no longer has any effect.

migrations.name: remove-platform-server-exports
migrations.description: Remove exported `@angular/platform-server` `renderModule` method. The `renderModule` method is now exported by the Angular CLI.

migrations.name: remove-show-circular-dependencies-option
migrations.description: Remove 'showCircularDependencies' option from browser and server builders.

migrations.name: remove-solution-style-tsconfig
migrations.description: Removing "Solution Style" TypeScript configuration file support.

migrations.name: rename-browserslist-config
migrations.description: Update Browserslist configuration file name to '.browserslistrc' from deprecated 'browserslist'.

migrations.name: renderer-to-renderer2
migrations.description: Migrates usages of Renderer to Renderer2

migrations.name: replace-default-collection-option
migrations.description: Replace 'defaultCollection' option in workspace configuration with 'schematicCollections'.

migrations.name: replace-deprecated-prod-flag
migrations.description: Replace the deprecated '--prod' in package.json scripts.

migrations.name: replace-ng-packagr-builder
migrations.description: Replace deprecated library builder '@angular-devkit/build-ng-packagr'.

migrations.name: replace-nguniversal-builders
migrations.description: Replace usages of '@nguniversal/builders' with '@angular-devkit/build-angular'.

migrations.name: replace-nguniversal-engines
migrations.description: Replace usages of '@nguniversal/' packages with '@angular/ssr'.

migrations.name: replace-provide-server-rendering-import
migrations.description: Migrate imports of 'provideServerRendering' from '@angular/platform-server' to '@angular/ssr'.

migrations.name: replace-provide-server-routing
migrations.description: Migrate 'provideServerRendering' to use 'withRoutes', and remove 'provideServerRouting' and 'provideServerRoutesConfig' from '@angular/ssr'.

migrations.name: router-current-navigation
migrations.description: Replaces usages of the deprecated Router.getCurrentNavigation method with the Router.currentNavigation signal

migrations.name: router-initial-navigation-options
migrations.description: Updates the `initialNavigation` property for `RouterModule.forRoot`.

migrations.name: router-last-successful-navigation
migrations.description: Ensures that the Router.lastSuccessfulNavigation signal is now invoked

migrations.name: router-link-empty-expression
migrations.description: Migrates `[routerLink]=""` in templates to `[routerLink]="[]"` because these links are likely intended to route to the current page with updated fragment/query params.

migrations.name: router-link-with-href
migrations.description: Since Angular v15, the `RouterLink` contains the logic of the `RouterLinkWithHref` directive. This migration replaces all `RouterLinkWithHref` references with `RouterLink`.

migrations.name: router-preserve-query-params
migrations.description: NavigationExtras.preserveQueryParams has been removed as of Angular version 11.  This migration replaces any usages with the appropriate assignment of the queryParamsHandler key.

migrations.name: router-relative-link-resolution-default
migrations.description:
The default value for `relativeLinkResolution` is changing from 'legacy' to 'corrected'.
This migration updates `RouterModule` configurations that use the default value to 
now specifically use 'legacy' to prevent breakages when updating.

migrations.name: safe-optional-chaining
migrations.description: Wraps optional chaining expressions in $safeNavigationMigration().

migrations.name: schematic-options-10
migrations.description: Replace deprecated and removed 'styleext' and 'spec' Angular schematic options with 'style' and 'skipTests', respectively.

migrations.name: schematic-options-12
migrations.description: Remove invalid 'skipTests' option in '@schematics/angular:module' Angular schematic options.

migrations.name: schematic-options-13
migrations.description: Remove no longer valid Angular schematic options from `angular.json`.

migrations.name: schematic-options-9
migrations.description: Replace deprecated 'styleext' and 'spec' Angular schematic options.

migrations.name: static-queries
migrations.description: Migrates ViewChild and ContentChild to explicit query timing

migrations.name: strict-safe-navigation-narrow
migrations.description: Disables the 'nullishCoalescingNotNullable & optionalChainNotNullable extended diagnostics.

migrations.name: strict-templates-default
migrations.description: Adds 'strictTemplates: false' in tsconfig.json when not set.

migrations.name: template-local-variables
migrations.description: Warns developers if values are assigned to template variables

migrations.name: test-bed-get
migrations.description: Replaces usages of the deprecated TestBed.get method with TestBed.inject

migrations.name: testbed-teardown
migrations.description: In Angular version 13, the `teardown` flag in `TestBed` will be enabled by default. This migration automatically opts out existing apps from the new teardown behavior.

migrations.name: transfer-state
migrations.description: Updates `TransferState`, `makeStateKey`, `StateKey` imports from `@angular/platform-browser` to `@angular/core`.

migrations.name: trust-proxy-headers
migrations.description: Add 'trustProxyHeaders' configuration to 'AngularNodeAppEngine' or 'AngularAppEngine'. For more information see: https://angular.dev/best-practices/security#configuring-trusted-proxy-headers

migrations.name: tslint-add-deprecation-rule
migrations.description: Add the tslint deprecation rule to tslint JSON configuration files.

migrations.name: tslint-version-6
migrations.description: Update tslint to version 6 and adjust rules to maintain existing behavior.

migrations.name: typed-forms
migrations.description: As of Angular version 14, Forms model classes accept a type parameter, and existing usages must be opted out to preserve backwards-compatibility.

migrations.name: undecorated-classes-with-decorated-fields
migrations.description: Undecorated classes with decorated fields migration. As of Angular 9, it is no longer supported to have Angular field decorators on a class that does not have an Angular decorator. Read more about this here: https://v9.angular.io/guide/migration-undecorated-classes

migrations.name: undecorated-classes-with-di
migrations.description: Undecorated classes with DI migration. As of Angular 9, it is no longer supported to use Angular DI on a class that does not have an Angular decorator. Read more about this here: https://v9.angular.io/guide/migration-undecorated-classes

migrations.name: update-angular-config
migrations.description: Remove deprecated options from 'angular.json' that are no longer present in v10.

migrations.name: update-angular-config-v11
migrations.description: Remove deprecated options from 'angular.json' that are no longer present in v11.

migrations.name: update-angular-config-v12
migrations.description: Remove deprecated options from 'angular.json' that are no longer present in v12.

migrations.name: update-angular-config-v13
migrations.description: Remove deprecated options from 'angular.json' that are no longer present in v13.

migrations.name: update-angular-packages-version-prefix
migrations.description: Update Angular packages 'dependencies' and 'devDependencies' version prefix to '^' instead of '~'.

migrations.name: update-gitignore
migrations.description: Updating '.gitignore' to include '.angular/cache'.

migrations.name: update-karma-main-file
migrations.description: Remove no longer needed require calls in Karma builder main file.

migrations.name: update-libraries-secondary-entrypoints
migrations.description: Remove 'package.json' files from library projects secondary entrypoints.

migrations.name: update-libraries-tslib
migrations.description: Update library projects to use tslib version 2 as a direct dependency. Read more about this here: https://v10.angular.io/guide/migration-update-libraries-tslib

migrations.name: update-libraries-v13
migrations.description: Update library projects to be published in partial mode and removed deprecated options from ng-packagr configuration.

migrations.name: update-module-and-target-compiler-options
migrations.description: Update 'module' and 'target' TypeScript compiler options. Read more about this here: https://v10.angular.io/guide/migration-update-module-and-target-compiler-options

migrations.name: update-module-resolution
migrations.description: Update 'moduleResolution' to 'bundler' in TypeScript configurations. You can read more about this, here: https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/#moduleResolution

migrations.name: update-server-builder-config
migrations.description: Update the '@angular-devkit/build-angular:server' builder configuration to disable 'buildOptimizer' for non optimized builds.

migrations.name: update-ssr-imports
migrations.description: Update '@angular/ssr' import paths to use the new '/node' entry point when 'CommonEngine' is detected.

migrations.name: update-tsconfig-target
migrations.description: Update TypeScript compilation target to 'ES2020'.

migrations.name: update-typescript-lib
migrations.description: Updates the 'lib' property in tsconfig files to use 'es2022' or a more modern version.

migrations.name: update-typescript-target
migrations.description: Update TypeScript compiler `target` and set `useDefineForClassFields`. These changes are for IDE purposes as TypeScript compiler options `target` and `useDefineForClassFields` are set to `ES2022` and `false` respectively by the Angular CLI. To control ECMA version and features use the Browerslist configuration.

migrations.name: update-web-workers-webpack-5
migrations.description: Updates Web Worker consumer usage to use the new syntax supported directly by Webpack 5.

migrations.name: update-workspace-config
migrations.description: Remove options from 'angular.json' that are no longer supported by the official builders.

migrations.name: update-workspace-dependencies
migrations.description: Update workspace dependencies to match a new v10 project.

migrations.name: update-workspace-dependencies-v11
migrations.description: Update workspace dependencies to match a new v11 project.

migrations.name: update-zonejs
migrations.description: Update 'zone.js' to version 0.11.x. Read more about this here: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/zone.js/CHANGELOG.md#breaking-changes-since-zonejs-v0111

migrations.name: use-application-builder
migrations.description: Migrate application projects using '@angular-devkit/build-angular:browser' and '@angular-devkit/build-angular:browser-esbuild' to use the '@angular-devkit/build-angular:application' builder. Read more about this here: https://angular.dev/tools/cli/esbuild#using-the-application-builder

migrations.name: wait-for-async
migrations.description: `async` to `waitForAsync` migration. The `async` testing function has been renamed to `waitForAsync` to avoid confusion with the native `async` keyword.

migrations.name: workspace-version-9
migrations.description: Angular Workspace migration. Update an Angular CLI workspace to version 9.

migrations.name: xhr-factory
migrations.description: `XhrFactory` has been moved from `@angular/common/http` to `@angular/common`.
